# Aurora Filtech Co., Ltd

> Manufacturer of paper machine clothing (PMC), industrial filter fabrics, spiral fabrics, square mesh belts, dust filter bags and filter cartridges. 30+ years of weaving expertise across 3 factories (German Dornier looms, full in-house chain from monofilament extrusion to finished cloth).

## Core Product Lines
- [Forming Fabric (Forming Wire)](https://www.aurora-filtech.com/forming-fabric/): 1-layer to 3-layer SSB anti-hydrolysis polyester forming fabrics for paper machines, nonwoven lines and flexible graphite sheet forming.
- [Dryer Fabric](https://www.aurora-filtech.com/dryer-fabric/): Anti-static dryer belts (wool scouring & wood panel forming), 4106S silicone-coated belts, spiral dryer fabrics, square mesh belts and flat-yarn paper dryer fabrics.
- [Spiral Fabric (Spiral Belt)](https://www.aurora-filtech.com/spiral-belt/): Open SP-D spiral dryer fabrics (875–1016 CFM) and filled SP-P spiral press filter belts (325–783 CFM) in PET, PPS (~240 °C) and PTFE-added grades.
- [Polyester Square Mesh](https://www.aurora-filtech.com/products/square-mesh/): Heat-set plain-weave (1/1) polyester monofilament square mesh (400–2100 µm, up to 1750 CFM) and 40–200 mesh sifting cloth.
- [Vacuum Filter Fabric](https://www.aurora-filtech.com/vacuum-fabric/): Horizontal vacuum belt filter, disc filter and drum filter cloths (models 610, 617, 620, 623, 623A, PP MD-series) for FGD gypsum, phosphoric acid and mining concentrates.
- [Press Filter Fabric](https://www.aurora-filtech.com/press-fabric/): Monofilament, multifilament and cotton filter press cloths for chamber, membrane and Larox-type vertical tower presses (up to 16 bar).
- [Press Filter Belt](https://www.aurora-filtech.com/press-belt/): Woven dewatering belts (models 601, 603, 604, 608, 613, 626, 656 PA nylon, 701) for belt press filters.
- [Filter Bag](https://www.aurora-filtech.com/products/filter-bag/): Baghouse dust collector bags in PET, PPS, Nomex, P84 and PTFE membrane.
- [Filter Cartridge](https://www.aurora-filtech.com/products/filter-cartridge/): Pleated dust, air, water and oil filter cartridges (anti-static, PTFE membrane, spun-bonded PET, cellulose, PPS/Nomex).
